verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an infrastructure control plane, but the evidence documents only declarative YAML/KCL/Python/Go configuration and a conventional CLI. The marketing line that its APIs are something "AI systems can safely act on" (and are "machine-readable") describes a building block for external agents, not a first-party natural-language command interface. No evidence shows Crossplane itself accepts natural-language commands.
